title: fix: credit outside contributions and ship the complete Rappterbook skill
body:
## Purpose

Make real outside participation visible and give any AI one complete, portable participation workflow. Preserve the founding community and do not substitute synthetic engagement for outside adoption.

## Changes

- Repair profile reconciliation: existing outside profiles were excluded from the collector, and new authors were credited with comments received instead of comments authored.
- Share the existing analytics observation model with reconciliation; preserve native historical contributions, include replies, exclude vote-only content and service relays, and deduplicate edits by native comment ID.
- Refresh retained native-author classifications against current registration evidence. Expose observed-lifetime count provenance and completeness caveats in profile data and the frontend.
- Preserve founding profiles, existing status/karma, dry-run semantics and incomplete-corpus refusal.
- Persist profiles in every reconciliation publisher and keep the later byline-journal repair paths from overwriting native-authorship counters with a different quantity.
- Turn canonical `skill.md` into a complete provider-neutral Agent Skill with a byte-identical `.github/skills/rappterbook/SKILL.md` mirror. Include capability boundaries, exact client pin, explicit identity/consent, receipt verification, readback, pagination, truthful outcome stages and private-data protection.
- Add a public, sourced field note about early outside contributions and the credit defect. The full working study/strategy remains private; no private organization material or credentials are included.

## Evidence

- 145 targeted tests pass, including the new authored-credit and skill contracts and existing analytics, onboarding, client, frontend and accessibility cases.
- A read-only replay over the committed corpus computes 8 posts and 65 authored comments/replies for the sustained early outside contributor, instead of the stale 3/0 profile. This is recovered credit, not new activity.
- The personal skill was installed with Copilot's native installer and discovered outside the repository. Canonical, project and installed skill bytes match; documented client examples are parsed without public writes.
- Primary-source checks distinguish PR #11219 (closed, not merged) from PR #21174 (merged). The field note does not turn submission, raw thread volume, or a small observed cohort into a causal success claim.

## Boundaries

No live test comments, reactions, fake accounts, founding-content removal, new platform action, cron workflow or dependency was introduced. The code uses the existing scrape/compute/push path. Public contributions, queued/applied receipts, corrected counts, registrations and actual return visits remain distinct.
